concerns.text: T005 requires `model_results_final.parquet` to conform to BOTH `gamm_results.schema.yaml` and `output.schema.yaml`, but these schemas have mutually exclusive required fields (`output.schema` requires grid_cell/model_id/term/fdr_q_value/r_squared; `gamm_results.schema` requires climate_variable/convergence_status/gp_included with additionalProperties:false). No single artifact can satisfy both, so the verification clause is unexecutable as written. Designate one schema or reconcile them.

Constitution Reproducibility Requirements mandate a pinned `requirements.txt` (or `pyproject.toml`) at `code/`, and Principle VII requires pinned package versions. No task creates or maintains this manifest; T001 creates `config.py` but not the dependency file, so the isolated-virtualenv execution premise has no implementing task and T012's clean re-run is not reproducible on a fresh runner.

T003's verification promises parquet columns (species, grid_cell, year, phenology metrics, climate_temp, climate_precip) conforming to `phenology_metric.schema.yaml` and `dataset.schema.yaml`, but the data model joins climate on `grid_cell` AND `week` while `PhenologyMetric` has `year` and no `week` field, and the schema has `additionalProperties:false` (no climate columns). The implementer cannot determine the join key or output shape; the schema-validation verification cannot pass. Specify the actual output schema (e.g., a joined wide schema) or reconcile the join key.

T001 offers a disjunctive, unresolved source for the migratory species list ('a pinned raw GitHub URL of a public migratory-species list, OR `datasets.load_dataset` of a real eBird-derived species dataset'). An implementer cannot deterministically pick the source; FR-002 names the Cornell Lab list. Name ONE concrete pinned source (URL or dataset id) in the task.

T006/T008 permit reducing 10,000 permutation shuffles to 1,000 'only if the 6-hour budget is genuinely exceeded, with a logged justification'. The trigger condition 'genuinely exceeded' is not measurable at task-execution time (the 6-hour budget applies to the whole pipeline, not this step). Define a concrete per-step wall-clock threshold or drop the fallback.

plan.md specifies a `src/`-rooted layout (`src/config.py`, `src/data/download.py`, `tests/unit/`) while every task builds under `code/` and `code/tests/`. An implementer following plan.md produces files no task verifies. Add a one-line note in tasks.md (or amend plan.md) recording the `code/` layout as authoritative so the deviation is documented, not silent.

US-1 Acceptance Scenario 1 requires verifying minimum weekly coverage per grid cell and phenology-metric coverage of species-year combinations, but T003's verification only checks columns and unit tests. Add a concrete coverage check (e.g., a logged coverage summary in `data/provenance/` or an assertion in `test_preprocess.py`) so the scenario is demonstrable.
